title: Great if you are mostly about skincare.
text: I have been getting the Allure beauty box for over a year, since I got a deal on a one year subscription.  I am not renewing next month.  If you like skin care items, this box is probably for you.  There are typically 2-4 of the items that are skin care of some kind.  As a bit of a beauty box junkie, I already have enough creams and serums to last for a couple of years.  I personally prefer boxes that are heavy on the makeup products.  If that’s you too, the Allure box isn’t for you.  Overall though, the value is good, and the products are usually nice, just not the right blend for me.
label: positive
